header: Builds "My English Book 4" – fourth-grade English syllabus – A4 portrait.

noteP: هٰذَا الكِتَابُ يُكْمِلُ تَعْلِيمَ الإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ: شُهُورُ السَّنَةِ، وَالمُضَارِعُ البَسِيطُ، وَالمَاضِي البَسِيطُ، وَالمُقَارَنَةُ، وَالحَيَوَانَاتُ حَوْلَ العَالَمِ، وَالعَادَاتُ الصِّحِّيَّةُ، مَعَ قِصَّتَيْنِ 🇬🇧
noteLi: اطْلُبُوا مِنْ طِفْلِكُمْ أَنْ يَحْكِيَ مَا فَعَلَهُ أَمْسِ بِالإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةِ.
قَارِنُوا الأَشْيَاءَ فِي البَيْتِ: bigger / smaller.
اقْرَؤُوا القِصَّتَيْنِ بِصَوْتٍ عَالٍ وَاسْأَلُوهُ عَنْهُمَا.
الكِتَابُ يُقْرَأُ مِنَ اليَسَارِ إِلَى اليَمِينِ.
blurb: A complete, colourful 3D English book – part 4, with Arabic meanings for every word.

units.title: Months of the Year
units.intro: There are twelve months in a year.

acts.title: Months quiz
rows: How many months are in a year?

units.title: Simple Present
units.intro: We use the simple present for habits: I read every day. With he / she / it we add -s.
items: She reads a story every night.

acts.title: Add -s or not?
rows: My father ... to work by car.

units.title: Simple Past
units.intro: We use the simple past for things that finished. Many verbs add -ed: play → played.

acts.title: Yesterday
acts.html:
I played football yesterday.لَعِبْتُ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ أَمْسِ
She visited her grandma.زَارَتْ جَدَّتَهَا
We watched the stars.شَاهَدْنَا النُّجُومَ
He cleaned his room.نَظَّفَ غُرْفَتَهُ
They helped their mother.سَاعَدُوا أُمَّهُمْ

units.title: Comparing
units.intro: We add -er to compare two things: big → bigger, fast → faster.
items: An elephant is bigger than a mouse.
A car is faster than a bike.
The tree is taller than the house.
A mouse is smaller than a cat.

acts.title: Choose
rows: A lion is ... than a cat.
A plane is ... than a car.
A snail is ... than a rabbit.
A baby is ... than his father.

units.title: Animals Around the World
units.intro: Animals live in different places. Each one is special.
items: The whale is the biggest animal in the sea.

acts.title: Animal facts
rows: Which animal can swim very well?
Which animal lives in the desert?
Which is the biggest sea animal?
Which animal runs fast in Africa?

units.title: Healthy Habits
units.intro: Healthy habits keep our bodies strong.
items: I brush my teeth twice a day.
I drink a lot of water.

acts.title: Healthy or not?
acts.hint: Tick ✓ for healthy and ✗ for not healthy
rows: I sleep very late every night.
I wash my hands before eating.
I drink a lot of soda.

units.title: Reading Time
units.intro: Read the stories and answer the questions.

acts.title: A Trip to the Farm
acts.html:
A Trip to the Farm 🐄

Last Saturday, Yusuf visited his uncle's farm.
He saw cows, sheep and chickens.
He fed the chickens and collected eggs.
In the evening, he drank fresh milk.
It was a wonderful day!

acts.title: Answer
rows: When did Yusuf visit the farm?

acts.title: The Kind Girl
acts.html:
The Kind Girl 🐦

Mariam found a small bird in the garden.
It could not fly.
She gave it water and some seeds.
After two days, the bird was strong.
It flew away and sang a happy song.

acts.title: Answer
rows: Where did Mariam find the bird?
